item.title: 🚀 Flawless trajectory: perfect launch from Plesetsk A test launch of a mobile-based intercontinental ballistic missile
item.description: 🚀 Flawless trajectory: perfect launch from Plesetsk ✅ A test launch of a mobile-based intercontinental ballistic missile was carried out at the Plesetsk State Test Cosmodrome. 📍 The training warheads arrived at the assigned area at the Kura training ground (Kamchatka Peninsula). All the assigned tasks have been fully completed. ▫️ The Strategic Missile Forces units trained redeployment to the launch battery deployment area with preparation and conduct of the launch. The purpose of the launch was to confirm the tactical, technical, and flight characteristics of the missile system. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Behind every success is comprehensive training Deputy Minister of Defence General of the Army Yunus-Bek Yevkurov inspected the facilities of the training and material base of th
item.description: Behind every success is comprehensive training Deputy Minister of Defence General of the Army Yunus-Bek Yevkurov inspected the facilities of the training and material base of the Combat Training Centre. He was presented with the following: ▫️ software and hardware systems for training military personnel, ▫️ advanced models of unmanned systems, weapons, and equipment, ▫️ training systems from industrial enterprises. 💬 Head of the Combat Training Directorate of the Main Directorate of Combat Training of the Russian Armed Forces Major General Vyacheslav Kozlovsky reported to the Deputy Minister of Defence on the results of testing of items developed within the framework of the 'Innovators of the Armed Forces 2026' competition. 📊 A total of 62 items were presented, including UGVs, UAVs, counter-UAV systems, and electronic components. Thirty of them successfully passed the trials. 🤝 The developer enterprises confirmed the novelty of the projects presented and examined the possibilities for integrating them into serial production. ✅ Based on the results of the field trials, the new training aids were found to be highly effective; recommendations for their further refinement were issued, and the procedure for their subsequent acceptance into service was defined. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29088

Behind every success is comprehensive training
Deputy Minister of Defence General of the Army Yunus-Bek Yevkurov inspected the facilities of the training and material base of the Combat Training Centre.
He was presented with the following:
▫️
software and hardware systems for training military personnel,
▫️
advanced models of unmanned systems, weapons, and equipment,
▫️
training systems from industrial enterprises.
💬
Head of the Combat Training Directorate of the Main Directorate of Combat Training of the Russian Armed Forces Major General Vyacheslav Kozlovsky reported to the Deputy Minister of Defence on the results of testing of items developed within the framework of the 'Innovators of the Armed Forces 2026' competition.
📊
A total of
62
items were presented, including UGVs, UAVs, counter-UAV systems, and electronic components. Thirty of them successfully passed the trials.
🤝
The developer enterprises confirmed the novelty of the projects presented and examined the possibilities for integrating them into serial production.
✅
Based on the results of the field trials, the new training aids
were found to be highly effective;
recommendations for their further refinement were issued, and the procedure for their subsequent acceptance into service was defined.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 Working together, thinking as one Combat training centre, Nizhny Novgorod region
item.description: Working together, thinking as one 📍 Combat training centre, Nizhny Novgorod region ✅ Unmanned systems teams, assault troops, and mobile fire groups practised joint actions based on experience gained from missions in the special operation zone. The organisation of combat training was personally inspected by Deputy Minister of Defence General of the Army Yunus-Bek Yevkurov. 📄 Key stages of a tactical-special training exercise: 🎮 Drone teams trained in conducting aerial reconnaissance, engaging targets with FPV drones, delivering ammunition, and evacuating wounded personnel using robotic platforms. 💥 Mobile firing groups eliminated aerial targets using BMP-2M, Shilka SFU, small arms, and special interceptor drones. ▫️ Assault detachments practised camouflaged and rapid entry to the enemy's positions on high-speed motor vehicles. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🇷🇺 Shaping strategic partnership through trust and transparency An inspection group from the People's Republic of China
item.description: Shaping strategic partnership through trust and transparency 🇷🇺 🇨🇳 An inspection group from the People's Republic of China visited facilities of the Eastern Military District in Primorsky Krai under multilateral agreements. 📑 The event was conducted as part of the implementation of the Shanghai (1996) and Moscow (1997) agreements between the Russian Federation, the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Kyrgyz Republic, the Republic of Tajikistan, and the People's Republic of China on confidence-building in the military field in the border area and on mutual reduction of armed forces in the border area. 🤝 These agreements became an important step in the development of strategic partnership relations between the states, laid a reliable foundation for military cooperation and helped ensure lasting peace and tranquillity on the borders of the participating countries. 📍 One of the key events was an inspection of a Guards rocket artillery formation of the Eastern Military District, stationed in Primorsky Krai. ✅ During the visit, the Chinese inspection group verified the Russian Federation's compliance with its international obligations and confirmed the high level of effectiveness of the control mechanisms provided for under the agreements with the PRC. 🕯 During the visit, the inspection group laid flowers at the Eternal Flame memorial complex. The joint work concluded with performances by creative ensembles of the Eastern Military District. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
